question: Who is the author of 'The Glass Palace"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amitav Ghosh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **'The Glass Palace'** is a historical novel written by **Amitav Ghosh**, an acclaimed Indian author.
 
• The book was published in the year **2000**.
 
• The novel spans across three generations and is set in **Burma (Myanmar), India, and Malaya**, blending fiction with historical events.
 
• It provides an insightful exploration of **colonialism, migration, and identity** in Southeast Asia during the British Empire.
 
• The book was shortlisted for several prestigious awards and is considered one of Ghosh's most influential works.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vikram Seth**

 
 
• He is a renowned Indian author and poet, best known for his novel **'A Suitable Boy'**, one of the longest novels ever published in a single volume.
 
• His works often explore themes of love, family, and social issues.
 
• He has also written poetry collections like **'Mappings'** and **'Beastly Tales'**.
 
 
 
• **Salman Rushdie**
 
 
• An Indian-born British-American author, Rushdie is famous for his novel **'Midnight's Children'**, which won the Booker Prize in 1981.
 
• His works often combine magical realism with historical fiction, exploring themes of migration, identity, and politics.
 
• He is also known for **'The Satanic Verses'**, a controversial novel that sparked global debates.
 
 
 
• **Raj Kamal Jha**
 
 
• He is an Indian author and journalist, known for his novels like **'The Blue Bedspread'** and **'She Will Build Him A City'**.
 
• Jha's writing often delves into urban life, exploring themes of alienation, social divides, and human relationships.
 
 
 
• **About 'The Glass Palace'**
 
 
• The novel intricately intertwines historical events such as the fall of the Konbaung Dynasty in Burma and the emergence of Indian nationalism.
 
• Amitav Ghosh's writing is celebrated for its detailed descriptions, profound character development, and exploration of complex socio-political themes.
